app.about_text:
PowDroid {version} is an off-device energy profiler for Android.

app.busy_quit: A session is being recorded or collected. Quit anyway? A recorded session can still be collected when PowDroid starts again.

checks.title: Configuration
checks.failed: Some checks failed. Fix them and restart PowDroid.

home.no_device_hint: Connect your phone over USB with USB debugging enabled.
home.unauthorized_hint: Accept the USB debugging prompt on your phone.
home.no_permissions: No permission to use the device
home.no_permissions_hint: On Linux, install the udev rules for Android devices (e.g. the android-sdk-platform-tools-common package) and add your user to the plugdev group, then plug the phone in again.
home.offline_hint: Unplug and plug the phone in again. If it stays offline, revoke the USB debugging authorizations in the developer options, then accept the prompt again.
home.not_ready_hint: Wait for the phone to finish starting, or plug it in again.
home.pending: The session of {session} was not collected: PowDroid was closed before reading the phone's data.
home.pending_collect_tooltip: Read the battery data of this session from its phone, which must be connected.
home.wifi_tooltip: Use the phone over Wi-Fi debugging: it can then be unplugged without losing its connection, and its data is collected without plugging it back in.
home.perfetto_tooltip: Record the battery with Perfetto, Android's tracing service: the coulomb counter in µAh and current samples twice a second instead of the battery statistics' mAh readings, plus the energy of each power rail on phones that measure them (mostly recent Pixels). PowDroid uses the battery statistics when Perfetto is not available (before Android 10), or when this option is off.
home.debug_tooltip: Write a detailed log of what PowDroid does (adb commands and answers, data read, errors) to attach to a bug report. It contains your device's serial number and model and paths on this computer.
home.debug_error: Could not write the debug log: {error}
home.instructions:
1. Enable USB debugging in the developer options and connect your phone.
  2. Disable Battery Saver and screen timeout; set brightness and volume to 50%.
  3. Close running apps and background services.
  4. Click Start recording, unplug the phone and run your scenario for at least 5 minutes.
  5. Plug the phone back in to collect the results (over Wi-Fi, they are collected when you stop).

wifi.title: Connect over Wi-Fi
wifi.switch_title: Switch the USB phone to Wi-Fi
wifi.switch_hint: {device} is connected over USB: PowDroid makes it also listen over Wi-Fi (adb tcpip 5555) and connects to it. The phone and this computer must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
wifi.switch_unavailable: Select a phone connected over USB on the home page to switch it to Wi-Fi.
wifi.pair_hint: On the phone, open Developer options › Wireless debugging › Pair device with pairing code, then enter the address and code it shows. Once paired, connect below with the address shown on the Wireless debugging screen.
wifi.paired: Paired with {address}: now connect to the phone below.
wifi.connect_hint: Enter the address and port of the phone: the one shown by Wireless debugging (Android 11+), or port 5555 after adb tcpip.
wifi.connected: Connected to {serial}: it is selected on the home page.

record.step_unplug_hint: The recording starts automatically as soon as the phone is unplugged.
record.step_recording_hint: Run your test scenario on the phone, then click Stop.
record.replugged_warning: The phone is plugged in: charging distorts the measurements. Unplug it until you stop the recording.
record.no_coulomb: This phone does not report its battery coulomb counter: PowDroid will estimate the energy from the battery level drops, which is much less precise. Record a long session: the battery level should drop by at least 10 % (for about ±10 %), or 20 % for ±5 %.
record.step_replug_hint: Battery data will be collected as soon as the phone is connected.
record.step_unplug_wifi_hint: The phone stays connected over Wi-Fi: the recording starts as soon as it runs on battery.
record.step_reconnect_wifi_hint: The phone is not connected over Wi-Fi any more: its battery data will be collected as soon as it is back.
record.add_marker_tooltip: Mark this moment of the session, e.g. the start of a step of your scenario: the report gives the energy of each part between markers.

report.title: Energy report
report.filter: Filter by app or wakelock name…
report.coverage_tooltip: Share of the session with a known current: not plugged in and, on phones without a coulomb counter, between the first and last battery level drops.
report.extrapolated_tooltip: The average power over all the time the phone was unplugged: an estimate of the energy it used, including the time when the current is not known. Shown when the measured time does not cover all of it.
